From the reflection, use the correct condition \(a_5-2b_2=a_3\).

Given \(b_2=r=4-d\),
\[
a_5-2b_2=a_3
\]
\[
(3+4d)-2(4-d)=3+2d
\]
\[
6d-5=3+2d \implies d=2.
\]
Thus
\[
a_n=3+2(n-1)=2n+1,\qquad b_n=2^{n-1}.
\]
So
\[
T_n=\sum_{k=1}^n \frac{2k+1}{2^{k-1}}.
\]
The terms are positive, so \(T_n\) increases to
\[
\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{2n+1}{2^{n-1}}
=2\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{n}{2^{n-1}}+\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac1{2^{n-1}}
=2\cdot 4+2=10.
\]
Thus \(T_n<10\) for all \(n\), and the minimum possible \(M\) is
\[
\boxed{10}
\]
